verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and quickly accessing one-time passwords. Its CLI shows items grouped into vaults, and the browser extension lets users "find what you need", which loosely implies search and grouping. Evidence for organizing dozens of TOTP codes specifically is thin. Missing for 10: explicit search documentation for OTP items, documented folder/tag/vault organization in the apps, service icons, and any hands-on or community corroboration of quick two-tap access at scale.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
